claim: Optimus reaches roughly one million units a year
caveat: The same programme structure as robotaxi, whose fleet promise went 500 to 60 to 20 in three months. Treat the stated figure as an intention rather than a forecast.

decision.decision: Ramp Optimus to about a million units a year

requirements.text: A single line must sustain a million units a year
The robot must do useful work unsupervised

steps.name: Prove the manual assembly process before automating the line
